Read-only-first substrate-readiness gate cleared; queue the MECH-294 behavioural-evidence successor (compose ON) to test whether the co-binding carries DOWNSTREAM signal -- that is the successor's job, NOT this gate's. Cross-stream norm-covariation corroborates (joint > shuffled on >= 2/3 seeds): co-observation, not just four-streams-present.
